import Mathlib

theorem aime_1988_p3 (x : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < x)

  have h₂ : x > 1 := by
    by_contra h
    -- Assume x ≤ 1 and derive a contradiction
    have h₂₁ : x ≤ 1 := by linarith
    have h₂₂ : Real.logb 2 (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
      have h₂₃ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := by
        -- Prove that logb 8 x ≤ 0 when x ≤ 1
        have h₂₄ : Real.logb 8 x = Real.log x / Real.log 8 := by
          rw [Real.logb]
        rw [h₂₄]
        have h₂₅ : Real.log x ≤ 0 := by
          -- Prove that log x ≤ 0 when x ≤ 1
          apply Real.log_nonpos
          · linarith
          · linarith
        have h₂₆ : Real.log 8 > 0 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
        have h₂₇ : Real.log x / Real.log 8 ≤ 0 := by
          exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h₂₅ (le_of_lt h₂₆)
        exact h₂₇
      have h₂₈ : Real.logb 2 (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
        -- Prove that logb 2 (logb 8 x) = 0 when logb 8 x ≤ 0
        have h₂₉ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := h₂₃
        have h₃₀ : Real.log (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
          -- Prove that log (logb 8 x) = 0 when logb 8 x ≤ 0
          have h₃₁ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := h₂₉
          have h₃₂ : Real.log (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
            -- Use the property of log for non-positive numbers
            have h₃₃ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := h₃₁
            have h₃₄ : Real.log (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
              -- Use the property of log for non-positive numbers
              have h₃₅ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := h₃₃
              have h₃₆ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0 := h₃₅
              have h₃₇ : Real.log (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
                -- Use the property of log for non-positive numbers
                rw [Real.log_eq_zero]
                <;>
                  (try norm_num) <;>
                  (try linarith) <;>
                  (try
                    {
                      by_cases h₃₈ : Real.logb 8 x ≤ 0
                      <;>
                        simp_all [Real.logb, Real.log_div, Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow]

                        norm_num at *

                        linarith

            exact h₃₄
          exact h₃₂
        have h₃₈ : Real.logb 2 (Real.logb 8 x) = 0 := by
          rw [Real.logb, h₃₀]
          <;> simp [Real.log_one, Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          <;> linarith
        exact h₃₈
      exact h₂₈
    have h₂₃ : Real.logb 8 (Real.logb 2 x) = 0 := by
      have h₂₄ : Real.logb 2 x ≤ 0 := by
        -- Prove that logb 2 x ≤ 0 when x ≤ 1
        have h₂₅ : Real.logb 2 x = Real.log x / Real.log 2 := by

        rw [h₂₅]
